payload.reason: The evidence discusses various datasets used in human language processing, including behavioral data (eye-tracking, self-paced reading) and neural data (EEG recordings).

claims.text: Heterogeneous datasets, including eye-tracking, self-paced reading, and ERP components, are used in human language processing.
Electroencephalography (EEG) recordings are widely used to study language comprehension.
Neural and behavioral data are used to train neural networks in language processing.
